description: U.S. Airports : ESRI Data & Maps 2010 is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Tele Atlas North America, Inc., Environmental Systems Research Institute (Redlands, Calif.). U.S. Airports represents airport grounds and airport runways within the United States. All airports have a boundary, and most have at least one runway. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2011. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page.
